caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of two long, slender metallic arms joined at a central pivot point, forming an open angle. The arm on the left side ends in a loop and has a smooth, straight shape. The arm on the right side ends in a flat, notched tip and has a slight curve near the end. Towards the top of the object, attached near the pivot, there is a flat, rectangular plate with beveled edges and faint engraved markings. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the object is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting a metallic material with subtle highlights and shadows to emphasize its three-dimensional form.
title: Oven
